offers_products.reason: Refines and sells gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, marine fuels and asphalt from its refineries in Hawaii, Washington, Wyoming and Montana.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from refined fuel sales; logistics and terminals mainly support its own product sales, not a main service line.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Owns Hawaii retail gas stations (Hele, nomnom) selling gasoline to motorists, though wholesale is larger.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells wholesale fuels, marine fuels, jet fuel and asphalt to contractors, airlines, shipping, roofing makers and distributors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Fuels are repeat-purchase commodities bought continually by distributors, airlines, shippers, contractors and motorists.

cyclical_demand.reason: Transportation and heating fuels are needed for ongoing operations; demand is fairly stable, though prices fluctuate.

big_ticket.reason: Fuel cargoes and rack loads are frequent, repeat commodity purchases, not rare large-ticket buys.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from refineries, terminals and fuel products, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are large fuel distributors, airlines, oil majors, shipping firms and government-contracted road builders.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates four refineries, marine terminals, pipelines and retail sites needing heavy ongoing capital investment.

notes: Website text focuses on the Washington refinery and U.S. Oil; the wider company also has Hawaii, Wyoming and Montana operations and retail.
